verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents exporting raw event data with all event properties as JSONL through the Raw Event Export API, which it recommends for high volume. User profiles can be exported via the Engage API and small batches as CSV from the UI, and a community user calls its export policy 'great'. Missing for 10: documented export of non-event assets (session replays, cohorts, report/dashboard definitions), a documented continuous bulk export to your own warehouse, and an account-closure/offboarding path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API. The events payload is returned as JSONL
The raw export API allows you to download your event data as it is received and stored within Mixpanel, complete with all event properties
To export User Profile data, use the Engage API.
You can export data from your project using a variety of methods, including lightweight CSVs generated from the UI, large volume raw data export from our APIs
